items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And so they got Jimmy Cole in the band... And I think Cole stayed with us then.

ctx.x: MR. RAMEY: Yeah. And he came up and he said, he gave us a lecture, you know, and we got to rehearsal, and he stopped us, and he came, and he says, you know, for every musician on this bandstand, we got musicians here in New York can blow rings around them. So no man is that important to this unit that they're going to ruin this thing. So as of this day I'm demanding Max Shann fire Charlie Parker immediately. So Max Shann let him go. Now, we were on our way back into the Apollo again. We had really upset them the…

And so they got Jimmy Cole in the band. Well, after about two weeks we started getting so many complaints and things, and Bird would come by, and different ones of us would give him some money to eat and so forth. He was still working at the Monroe's Uptown House, you know, after hour joint, but he didn't make no money.

And so I got McShann to let me -- let me hire Bird and he pay me -- you know, I'd act as Bird's agent. And I'd take care of him, you know. So we got Bird back in the band. And I think Cole stayed with us then. He did and started playing baritone.
